title: Sentinel Flask Preparation for Cold Shipping Protocol of Human Islets
author: Integrated Islet Distribution Program
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bhdpj25n
materials: The following supplies are necessary for the preparation of Sentinel Test Flasks for human islet distribution. Islet preparation for distribution Wide mouth pipettes and pipettor 30 mL shipping bottles - 1 per islet purity batch broadcasted. Shipping media that is to be used for distribution as decribed below.

steps.title: Prepare PIM(T) Complete Media
steps.instruction: Prepare 1 bottle of PIM(T) media by adding specific supplements to create PIM(T) complete.

substeps.instruction: Thaw and add 5 mL of PIM(G).
Add 12.5 mL of AB serum (2.5%v/v) (heat inactivated Gemini AB serum).
Add 0.5 mL of prepared sterile ciprofloxacin aliquot.

steps.title: Assemble Materials
steps.instruction: Assemble all items described in the Material and Media Preparation Sections.

steps.title: Calculate Islet Suspension Volume
steps.instruction: Consolidate and count cultured islets to calculate the volume (y μL) needed to provide at least 100 IEQs using the formula: Total IEQ/(Total mL * 1000 μL) = x IEQ/μL, then 100 IEQ/x IEQ/μL = y μL.

steps.title: Prepare Sentinel QA Flasks
steps.instruction: Prepare the shipping flask for each purity batch being distributed.

substeps.instruction: Thoroughly resuspend the preparation with a large mouth pipet.
Remove the calculated aliquot and place it in a 30mL shipping flask.
Top with the appropriate amount of the same batch of PIM(T) complete media used for distribution.

steps.title: Incubate Sentinel Flasks
steps.instruction: Simulate shipping and investigator culture conditions by incubating the flasks.

substeps.instruction: Store Sentinel QA Flask(s) between 4°C and 8°C for approximately 18 hours.
Move flask(s) to a 37°C incubator for an additional 2 days.

steps.title: Monitor and Document Quality
steps.instruction: Perform daily quality checks and document findings.

substeps.instruction: Observe under a microscope daily for visual islet integrity, quality, and sterility.
Record results on Attachment 2 - Sentinel Flask Documentation Sheet.

steps.title: Report Sterility Issues
steps.instruction: If a sterility problem is identified, alert the IIDP and the islet recipients.

substeps.instruction: Send a copy of the Attachment 1-Sentinel Flask Documentation Sheet to IIDP.
Provide photographs of the visual state of the sentinel flask if required.
